title: RentObligation
description: A verifiable housing obligation. Contains protocol identifiers only — never PII. Renter and landlord identity live in a private vault keyed by party IDs. Current status is DERIVED from the RentEvent history; the status field here is a cached projection, not authoritative state.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record was written against.

obligation_id.description: Globally unique obligation identifier. Opaque; carries no PII.

agreement_id.description: The lease/agreement this obligation arises from. One agreement produces many obligations (typically one per period).

renter_party_id.description: Opaque party identifier for the obligor. PII resolved only in the private identity vault.

landlord_party_id.description: Opaque party identifier for the obligee.

property_reference.description: Opaque property/unit reference. Never a street address.

amount_due.description: Amount due in MINOR units of `currency` (e.g. cents for USD). Integers avoid floating-point drift in multi-source resolution math.

due_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp (UTC) when the obligation is contractually due.

period.description: Optional obligation period, e.g. the rental month this covers.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166 country or country-subdivision code (e.g. US-CA). Determines applicable resolution and disclosure rules.

policy_reference.description: Optional reference to the deterministic landlord policy governing modifications (extensions, splits, arrangement limits).

status.description: Cached projection of event-derived state. `satisfied` requires ObligationSatisfied; `in_resolution` means an active modification/assistance/financing flow; `unresolved` is a terminal default only after resolution paths are exhausted or expired.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp (UTC) when the obligation record was created.
